anomalies.observed: The reference designator U26 is assigned to two different components on two different sheets: on the I/O sheet it labels the PCA9536D I2C GPIO expander (pins 100-103 driving 5V_CAN_ENABLE, SER_SELECT, EXTRA_GPIO), and on the USB sheet it labels one of the USBLC6-2P6 USB ESD/TVS arrays (the companion array being U25).
anomalies.expected: Every component must carry a unique reference so the BOM and placement netlist resolve to two distinct parts; the PCA9536D and the USBLC6-2P6 are unrelated devices and cannot share a designator.

anomalies.impact: A duplicated reference is a design/assembly error: during BOM generation and pick-and-place the two parts collide, so one of them (either the I2C expander that drives 5V_CAN_ENABLE/SER_SELECT/EXTRA_GPIO, or the USB ESD protection on the USB-A port) will be omitted or populated with the wrong part, breaking that function.
